text:
Type: two-tone wooden desk with drawers
Use: working, writing; home office, study, bedroom, living room
Style: farmhouse, rustic, traditional
Materials: solid pine top in a clear natural finish, black stained solid pine base, round black knobs
Colors: light warm pine, black
Shape: wide rectangular top with a rounded edge, two stacked drawers on one side, black apron, four tall slim tapered legs, open, medium weight
Feel: warm, rustic, honest, inviting
Goes with: black windsor chairs, white walls, warm wood, wrought iron; farmhouse, rustic or classic home offices
